_comment: Demo_Game activity definitions — loaded at runtime by DemoQuestManager::TryLoadFromJSON. These override the C++ defaults in demo_quest_manager.cpp when ENGINE_ENABLE_JSON is active. See docs/DEMO_GAME.md for gameplay details.

mainQuest.title: Tour of the Engine
mainQuest.description: Walk up to each teaching station and press E to read the lesson. Use the F1 overlay to teleport to stations if needed, then press E when you arrive to continue the tour.

objectives.description: Press E at the Quests & Dialogue station
Press E at the Action Combat station
Press E at the PBR Rendering station to complete the tour

activities.title: Lesson Reader
activities.description: Press E at 3 different teaching stations to read their lessons. Use F1 to navigate to stations.

activities.title: Code Explorer: Combat
activities.description: Press E at the Action Combat station to read the ComboSystem lesson.

activities.title: Code Explorer: Rendering
activities.description: Press E at the PBR Rendering station to read the BRDF pipeline lesson.
